scope: Offline original executable/type/role bootstrap model and original-kernel source review. Not actual context assignment, syscall, service readiness, policy loading or APK acceptance
initial_control: Variant1 assumed kernel_t from displayed kernel string. Reference source shows INIT alias; initial compiled control retained, final model strictly init_t. Numeric live SID and post-load creator still require observation.

model.creator: linux.system_u:linux.system_r:linux.init_t:s0
model.file_contract: Intended immutable root-owned0700 Rust supervisor, not installed or verified. Global neverallow forbids every type creating, modifying or relabelling this entry type; separate authenticated installation/provenance remains unresolved.
model.mechanism: Original type/role transition through labelled entry file, then explicit original exec context toward Android. No dependency on PID1 SELinuxContext property claimed.
model.ordering: Linux creator performs privileged namespace/root/credential preparation before Rust supervisor actor. Existing NativeProcess then creates channel in actor before child exec, so original coordinator uses actor-opened FD. No extra SCM_RIGHTS or lifetime protocol invented.

results.checked_edges: creator→actor→coordinator selected TE/MLS/RBAC and process2 NNP/nosuid permissions; source context preserved appropriately, socket context and control rights computed
results.recovery: NativeProcess Child::kill has source-justified sigkill only toward coordinator, not manager/host; actual kill/wait/pidfd under labels untested
results.producer_controls: Other modeled kernel_t/sshd/unconfined/app contexts denied enter/execute; model does not distinguish Unix UID, root DAC0700 still mandatory
results.cohort_gap: Six original manager exec process2 NNP/nosuid checks denied. Final export has no typebounds, so bounded fallback not supplied in model. With inherited flags and enforcing reference checks, do not assume managers execute despite passing first two edges.
results.label_guard: Six creator create/write/append/setattr/relabelto/relabelfrom decisions denied; global neverallow assertions compile. No live labelling or exploit tested.

limitations: Before-policy kernel string is an alias and not proof of a real kernel_t producer. Final source init_t model is reference-derived; actual Arch package source/build equivalence and post-load identity not proved

Typed root entry DAC/hash/inode stability, filesystem association/labels installation, credentials/caps/secure-exec/NNP flags and actual root layout have not been tested. No inode is labelled or package installed
Actor must remain the Rust parent that creates control channel; preceding diagnostic supervisor→unshare pipeline cannot be reused unchanged after actor role because administrative MAC checks denied
Normal stdio/other inherited FDs, PIDFD and cgroup operations/labels, expected context guard and actor host-library view need complete contract/testing, not just a computed socket context
SIGCHLD probe was denied, but no task_wait hook found in reviewed reference; do not claim waitpid fails solely from that permission or add it as a guessed fix. Only source-backed sigkill bridge added
Targeted process2 permissions do not turn off Unix NNP or nosuid semantics; original flags remain. Passing those permissions offline is not actual execution, and downstream cohort checks are unmet
No per-manager NNP workaround or silent NoNewPrivileges removal. Evaluate original init/service/zygote lifecycle as whole, including app boundary, before choosing further adaptation
Source utilities run as host tools, not REA MCP. Source-available analysis needs no opaque target; no CLI invocation presented as connection
Default policy profile, earlier six pending changes and original caches preserved. New source snapshot separate. No load/enforce/relabel/reboot or Android boot
ARM, external services/DRM, Markor full nine-stage matrix remain unchanged
